previous_experiences: Founded BYD Company in 1995 outside Shenzhen with a loan from his cousin, starting as a battery maker with 20 employees.
Grew BYD into the world's largest plug-in electric vehicle manufacturer and world's largest mobile phone battery manufacturer.
Secured a US$230 million investment from Berkshire Hathaway (Warren Buffett) in September 2008 for a ~9.89% stake.
Served as General Manager of BAK Battery Co., Ltd. (1993–1995), gaining experience in business management and battery manufacturing.
BYD entered the automotive industry in 2003, expanding from batteries into EVs.
Topped Fortune's List of China's 50 Most Influential Business Leaders in 2023.
Met with CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping in February 2025 as a recognized national champion of Chinese industry.
bio_text: Wang Chuanfu is a Chinese chemist-turned-entrepreneur who founded BYD Company in 1995 and built it into a Fortune 500 conglomerate spanning electric vehicles, batteries, rail transit, and electronics — now the world's largest plug-in EV manufacturer. He spends 60–70% of his time on technology and product development and has long bet that EVs would allow China to leapfrog internal combustion engine development entirely. Backed by Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway since 2008, he is widely regarded as one of China's most influential business leaders.
